context: Lower-level rifampicin resistance, strongly enriched among rifampicin-resistant / rifabutin-susceptible clinical isolates (OR 17.2).
notes: STRETCH CASE, NOT A PASS/FAIL GATE. Whether D435V truly preserves rifabutin activity is disputed: clinical isolate data strongly associate it with rifabutin susceptibility, but biochemistry conflicts - one isogenic study saw an MIC rise for rifampicin only, another saw IC50 rises for both. Discordance may be an artefact of the 0.5 mg/L critical concentration. Good demo material: the pipeline can offer a binding-level opinion on a genuinely open question, which is a stronger story than re-deriving settled facts.
source: Farhat et al. 1000-isolate study; 2023 meta-analysis of 4333 isolates
